name: Subsidy for Battery Operated 2-Wheelers
benefit: - **Subsidy Assistance:** Each eligible student receives a subsidy of ₹12,000/- for the purchase of a battery-operated two-wheeler.
_eligibility_text: 1. The applicant must be a student. 1. The applicant must be studying in Class 9th to 12th in the state or be a college student. 1. The applicant must purchase a battery-operated two-wheeler only from GEDA-authorized manufacturers through registered dealers.
